name: Frost Glass
description: A pane that frosts over when left alone; the pointer wipes a clear path, and the frost creeps back in from the edges.

props.name: children
props.description: What sits behind the glass. It fills the pane; size the pane with className.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of the wiped path, in pixels.

props.name: refreeze
props.description: How long a wiped area stays clear before the frost starts growing back into it, in milliseconds.

props.name: density
props.description: How thick the frost is, from 0 (a light mist) to 1.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the pane, which is rounded, clipped and focusable. Keyboard focus clears the frost until focus leaves. Other div props are passed through; set aria-label to name what is behind the glass.
